meta.name: The Bondsman
meta.description: Backwoods bounty hunter Hub Halloran comes back from the dead with an unexpected second chance at life, love, and a nearly-forgotten musical career — only to find that his old job now has a demonic new twist.

videos.title: Pot O'Gold
videos.overview: Hub Halloran starts out on an earthbound revenge story, but quickly realizes he might be in a supernatural one.

videos.title: Valacor
videos.overview: Hub learns more about his new job working for the devil and encounters his first demon.

videos.title: Marphos
videos.overview: Hub tries to turn Cade against Lucky and winds up using him for cover as he hunts another demon.

videos.title: Erdos
videos.overview: Maryanne, on a mission to reprimand Hub for hurting Cade, stumbles into the world of demons.

videos.title: Slypharis
videos.overview: Midge's emotional reason for joining Pot O' Gold comes to light. Hub puts together the pieces of a bigger mystery and tries to recruit Midge's help.

videos.title: Revelations
videos.overview: Lucky exacts his revenge on Hub only to be caught in a demon battle.

videos.title: Pyralis
videos.overview: Hub and Midge try to prevent the end times.

videos.title: Lilith
videos.overview: Losing the thing he loves the most, Hub is finally forced to confront his greatest sin. He sets out for a last shot at redemption by stopping a demonic force that's been unleashed from Hell.
